humanizer.planning: Include for documentation, public-facing copy, interface text, and release notes. Preserve technical terms, facts, code, and structured data.
humanizer.instructions: Use when writing or revising public-facing copy, interface text, articles or documentation. Preserve meaning, facts and technical terms. Skip code-only changes.

rtk.planning: Prefer for verbose command output in routine terminal-based coding.

ponytail.planning: Prefer for focused changes, maintenance, and scope control when it fits the project.

headroom.planning: Prefer when compatible and long sessions, large tool responses, heavy retrieval, multiple services, or substantial logs are likely. Use its local compression.

graphify.planning: Prefer when the agent needs to navigate a substantial existing repository or understand dependencies.

omniroute.planning: Use only when model routing or a self-hosted gateway is useful.

claude-mem.planning: Consider for cross-session memory in long-lived or resumed projects when its supported integration works with an available model. Explain model consumption and skip when setup requires a new paid service.

claude-code-setup.planning: Prefer for first-time Claude Code configuration or projects that benefit from tailored Claude Code automation.

vercel-react-best-practices.planning: Prefer for React or Next.js projects.

site-replica.planning: Use only when the user explicitly requests rebuilding a site they own or have permission to reproduce and the workflow is compatible.
